}}'''Nadric''' is a [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Nadric}}

== Appearance ==
He is a massive man, around seven feet tall and thick in proportion but not fat.

== Activities ==
He is one of the many Shaido camped in [[Malden]]. He takes [[Faile Bashere]] down a side alley to take advantage of her but is warned off by [[Rolan]]. He leaves without a fight.{{ref/book|10|9}}
